subject.title: fix(voice-call): persist assistant transcript on call.speaking events

question: Should this PR keep the boot-run session/memory changes, or should it be narrowed to the voice-call transcript fix before review continues?
rationale: The branch mixes a valid voice-call transcript bug fix with boot/session-memory behavior that touches prompt-disclosure and memory-ingestion boundaries; automation cannot safely choose that scope or security tradeoff.

options.title: Narrow To Voice Fix
options.body: Rebase and keep only the voice-call transcript work, fixing duplicate transcript paths and preserving current main safeguards before merge.

options.title: Split Boot Work
options.body: Move the boot-run key, host SDK export, memory ingestion, and reaper changes into a separate PR with dedicated security and upgrade proof.

options.title: Accept Combined Scope
options.body: A maintainer may intentionally keep the combined branch, but it still needs conflict resolution, security review, and inspectable real behavior proof.

recommendation.title: Narrow To Voice Fix
recommendation.body: Rebase and keep only the voice-call transcript work, fixing duplicate transcript paths and preserving current main safeguards before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the current assignee and has recent history on the voice-call and Google realtime surfaces that motivated the PR.
